material_defect_repaired: original preregistration did not numerically bound all serialization-size-driving dimensions, so A001 could not PROVE input_token_limit/max_seq_len accommodate every legal episode

notes.value_cap_uniform: max_value_len applies uniformly to attribute values, event values, and condition literals (numeric or opaque categorical); conservative over-approximation for a safe zero-truncation guarantee
notes.ids_char_level_opaque: IDs are ASCII char-level, non-lexeme, non-answer-encoding, unique within an episode
notes.R12_distractors: realized within max_entities/max_relations/max_events; not a separate unbounded dimension

cap_rationale_summary.max_relations_20: 12 entities with 3-hop discovery plus confusable near-duplicate paths (~1.7 relations/entity); bounds distractor branching without removing multi-hop discovery
cap_rationale_summary.max_hops_3: matches preregistered R3/R4 '2-3 hops'; not a narrowing
cap_rationale_summary.max_policies_4: one applicable + up to 3 near-miss distractor policies; preserves policy selection difficulty
cap_rationale_summary.max_conditions_per_policy_4: composite typed conditions (temporal + attribute + relational) preserved
cap_rationale_summary.max_evidence_16: required-support set + distractor evidence; preserves evidence precision/recall
cap_rationale_summary.max_attributes_per_entity_3: preserves intended fact density for policy-condition reference
cap_rationale_summary.max_id_len_6: unique + copyable within episode; opaque, does not encode the answer
cap_rationale_summary.max_numeric_digits_9: enterprise amounts up to 999,999,999; supports amount-threshold policies
cap_rationale_summary.max_sequence_digits_2: >= 48 events fit in 2 digits; preserves temporal ordering

maximal_legal_fixture_tokens_tokenizer_o.method: frozen A001 tokenizer + compact serializer; boundary fixture saturating ALL compatible caps simultaneously; handcrafted; no model/seeds
maximal_legal_fixture_tokens_tokenizer_o.joint_saturation_note: PATH_GIVEN vs PATH_DISCOVERY query-line difference is <= 3 tokens; the fixture uses the longest (PATH_GIVEN 3-chain) query line as a strict upper bound over all splits

context_sizing.rule: worst legal input + 20% margin, round up to 64; output floor 384; no truncation

A_capacity_increase_override.override: Amendments 001/002 supersede that item ONLY for lexical representation capacity (tokenizer vocabulary; token-embedding rows) and sequence capacity (positional-embedding rows)

B_p0_tokenizer_naming.clarification: P0 and R1-R12 use the SAME BTRR-specific frozen tokenizer introduced by Amendment 001
B_p0_tokenizer_naming.invariant: same tokenizer + same checkpoint for P0 and R1-R12 (not reuse of the single-hop tokenizer implementation)
